value.name: os_metadata
value.command: $executionIdentity = [System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent(); $serviceMetadata = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -Filter "Name='com.docker.service'" | Select-Object Name,State,StartName,ProcessId,PathName); $backendMetadata = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='com.docker.backend.exe'" | Select-Object Name,ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CreationDate); [PSCustomObject]@{ principal_name=$executionIdentity.Name; principal_sid=$executionIdentity.User.Value; authentication_type=$executionIdentity.AuthenticationType; docker_service=$serviceMetadata; docker_backends=$backendMetadata } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6

limits: Named pipe endpoint and actual external Docker daemon are observed local control infrastructure, not inferred project or policy authority.
com.docker.service returned no matching service; do not infer Docker absence because observed per-user backend processes and daemon exist.
Windows principal and process creation metadata are provenance facts, not issuer trust, policy approval or independent source acceptance.
Exact custodian launch/build/channel/context and distinct qualification/acceptance are still required.
No DB or external network contacted; no security settings changed.
